offers_products.reason: Sells vehicle transport and logistics; no goods are sold. Repair facilities support its own fleet.

offers_services.reason: Finished-vehicle trucking, dealer relocation, storage and brokerage services for automakers and dealers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are OEMs, dealers, auctions, rental and leasing fleets; individuals are mentioned only marginally.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Automakers, EV makers, dealers, auctions, rental fleets and leasing providers buy its transport.

recurring_revenue.reason: Long-standing OEM relationships with repeat vehicle hauling to dealerships, ongoing shipments rather than one-off projects.

cyclical_demand.reason: Volumes depend on new vehicle production and sales, which fall in recessions.

big_ticket.reason: Each vehicle delivery is a routine, frequent freight move, not a large infrequent purchase.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from its fleet of over 1,350 trucks and terminal network, an asset-based trucking service.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are global automakers (100% of OEMs serving the domestic market) and large fleet providers.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs a large truck and trailer fleet, terminals and repair facilities needing ongoing investment.
